meta.title: Gnutube — Tanzania, place by place
meta.description: See what travellers share, read their experiences and put together your own trip through Tanzania. From safari to beach.

cookies.title: Cookies and videos
cookies.intro: What Gnutube stores, what TikTok does and how you choose.
cookies.ownP: Gnutube does not set tracking cookies itself and uses no visitor analytics. We only store your choice about videos, with the date you chose, in your own browser’s storage. This information is not sent to us. If you add places to your trip or like something in the videos, that too is only stored in your own browser.
cookies.tiktokP: The videos come directly from TikTok, through the official TikTok player. As soon as a video loads, your browser connects to TikTok. TikTok may then use cookies and similar technologies and process data such as your IP address and how you watch the video. That falls under TikTok’s own privacy policy. That is why we only connect to TikTok if you agree.
cookies.choiceP: If you choose ‘Yes, please’, all videos load automatically. If you choose ‘No thanks’, nothing from TikTok loads until you click ‘Load video’ on a video yourself. You can change or withdraw your choice at any time; loaded videos then disappear immediately.
cookies.whoP: [Name of the organisation behind Gnutube and contact details still to be added.]

post.intro: Been to Tanzania? Show others what it was really like, with your own video.

post.checkOwn: I made this video myself, it’s public on TikTok and embedding is turned on.
post.checkPeople: Anyone recognisable in the video knows I’m sharing it and is fine with it. Recognisable children only with their parents’ permission.
post.checkRules: I follow the house rules and allow Gnutube to show the video on the site through the TikTok player.

post.rule1: Only your own video, of a place in Tanzania you actually visited.
post.rule2: No hate, violence, nudity, or dangerous or illegal content.
post.rule3: Respect animals and people: keep your distance from wildlife, don’t feed or chase animals and don’t drive off the tracks. Ask before you film people.
post.rule4: No ads or prices from travel companies: just your honest experience.
post.rule5: Gnutube may refuse or remove videos that break these rules.
post.how1: You send the link to your video.
post.how2: Someone from Gnutube reviews it before it goes online.
post.how3: Approved? It appears on the place page and in the videos, with your name and a link to your profile. Delete it on TikTok and it disappears here too.

partners.title: Become a Gnutube partner
partners.intro: Run a lodge, camp, safari company or activity in Tanzania? Show travellers what you offer, right when they choose their trip.
partners.why1p: Travellers choose their trip here by watching videos. Your lodge, tour or activity appears at the place they’re watching.
partners.why2p: Travellers put their whole trip up for auction, with route, dates, group size and maximum budget. You make a closed bid; the traveller compares and chooses.
partners.why3p: We work with businesses in Tanzania itself. Travellers see who you are and what you do, without made-up promises.

terms.title: Terms
terms.intro: What applies when you use Gnutube to put a trip up for auction or to bid on one.
terms.draft: Draft. These terms must be checked by a lawyer before Gnutube goes live. Everything in [square brackets] still needs to be filled in. Under consumer law not every limitation of liability is allowed; the lawyer decides the final wording.
terms.s1p: Gnutube ([company name], [address], [registration number]) runs a platform where travellers put their trip up for auction and approved companies bid on it. Gnutube does not organise, sell or carry out trips itself and is not a tour operator or travel organiser.
terms.s2p: A traveller sets the number of travellers and a maximum budget. For 3 days, approved companies place closed bids. When the auction closes, the traveller sees all bids without the company names and chooses one or none. Gnutube does not check whether a bid is correct, complete or achievable.
terms.s3h: Your agreement is with the company
terms.s3p: If you choose a bid, the agreement about the trip is made directly between you and the company. Gnutube is not a party to that agreement. The company’s own terms apply to the trip, including payment, changes and cancellation.
terms.s4p: When you choose a bid, you pay a deposit to Gnutube equal to Gnutube’s commission ([percentage]% of the price). This is the fee for bringing you together. You pay the rest directly to the company. [When and whether the deposit is refunded, for example if the company cancels, is to be decided by the lawyer.]
terms.s5p: The company is fully responsible for carrying out the trip: stays, transport, guides, activities, safety, permits and insurance. Gnutube has no influence over this and gives no guarantee about quality, availability or whether the trip goes ahead.
terms.s6p: Gnutube is not liable for damage, loss, delay, illness, accidents, cancellation, bankruptcy of a company or any other problem with the trip, or for anything a company does or fails to do. As far as the law allows, Gnutube’s liability is in any case limited to the amount of the deposit you paid. This does not apply to damage caused intentionally or through gross negligence by Gnutube itself. [To be checked by the lawyer.]
terms.s7p: Companies can only bid after Gnutube has approved their application. Approval means that Gnutube has [describe what is checked]; it is not a guarantee of the company’s quality or reliability. You choose a company yourself and are responsible for that choice.
terms.s8p: Gnutube advises you to take out travel and cancellation insurance yourself. Gnutube does not arrange insurance.
terms.s9p: Before the deposit is paid, travellers and companies must not share contact details, or arrange a trip found through Gnutube outside Gnutube. Gnutube may remove auctions and bids and block accounts that break these rules.
terms.s10p: Complaints about the trip go to the company. Complaints about Gnutube’s own service go to [email address]; Gnutube responds within [number] days. Gnutube can help mediate between you and a company, but is not obliged to. [Applicable law and competent court to be filled in.]

auction.startTitle: Put your trip up for auction
auction.startSub: Approved local companies bid on your whole trip. You only see the prices once the auction closes, and then you decide.
auction.step1: You set the number of travellers and your maximum budget for the whole group.
auction.step2: For 3 days, approved companies bid. They never see your name or contact details.
auction.step3: When the auction closes, you compare all bids side by side and choose one, or none.
auction.step4: If you choose a bid, you pay a deposit to Gnutube. Only then do you and the company see each other’s details.
auction.startNoCommit: You’re not committing to anything. If no bid suits you, you say no and that’s the end of it.
auction.disabled: Auctions work once the database is switched on.
auction.loginFirst: Sign in to put your trip up for auction
auction.maxBudget: Maximum budget for the whole group
auction.budgetHint: Companies can’t bid above this amount.
auction.name: Your name
auction.notePlaceholder: For example: tented camps preferred, a child seat in the car, or an extra day on Zanzibar.
auction.noteNoContact: Don’t put a name, email address or phone number here: companies can read this note.
auction.privateNote: Your name, email and phone stay private. A company only sees them after you choose its bid and pay the deposit.
auction.incomplete: Fill in the number of travellers, a start date in the future, a budget and your name, and tick the box.
auction.failed: That didn’t work. Please try again later.
auction.tooMany: You already have 2 auctions running. Wait until one closes, or stop one under My auctions.
auction.sentText: Companies can bid for the next 3 days. Once it closes, you’ll see all bids under My auctions.
auction.mineSub: Follow your auctions, compare the bids and choose.
auction.mineEmpty: You don’t have any auctions yet. Plan your trip and put it up for auction at the bottom of the page.
auction.bidsSoFar: {n, plural, =0 {No bids yet} one {# bid so far} other {# bids so far}}. You’ll see the prices when the auction closes.
auction.noBids: There were no bids on this auction.
auction.acceptConfirm: You’ll pay a deposit of {deposit} to Gnutube. You pay the remaining {rest} directly to the company. The other bids will be closed.
auction.declineAll: None of these bids? Say why (the companies will see your reason)
auction.reasonPlaceholder: For example: too expensive, or I’m not travelling after all
auction.reasonShared: Your reason is shown to the companies without your name, so they can bid better next time.
auction.depositText: The deposit is Gnutube’s fee. After paying, you’ll see the company’s name and contact details. You pay the remaining {rest} directly to the company, on its own terms.
auction.testBanner: Test mode: no real money is paid yet.
auction.contactText: The company will contact you about the details and the remaining {rest}. From here on, your agreement is with the company.
